name: Garlic Soy Chicken Stir-Fry with Broccoli
pitch: A classic weeknight winner — savory, satisfying, and on the table in under 25 minutes.
steps: Slice chicken into thin strips and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a splash of oil in a large pan or wok over high heat. Add chicken and cook 4–5 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Add broccoli to the same pan with a splash of water and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
Return chicken to the pan. Mix together 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp vinegar, and a pinch of garlic, then pour over everything.
Toss to coat, cook 1 more minute, and serve over rice or as-is.

name: Sheet Pan Roasted Chicken and Broccoli
pitch: Toss everything on one pan and let the oven do the work — simple but genuinely delicious.
steps: Cut chicken into pieces (thighs or breasts both work) and toss with oil, garlic, salt, pepper, and your favorite dried spices — paprika or Italian seasoning are great here.
Cut broccoli into florets and toss with oil, salt, and pepper on the same sheet pan.
Spread everything in a single layer and roast for 25–30 minutes, flipping halfway, until chicken is cooked through and broccoli edges are a little crispy.
Serve straight from the pan — fewer dishes, more smiles.

name: Chicken and Broccoli Soup
pitch: Warm, cozy, and endlessly comforting — this is the kind of soup that feels like a hug on a busy night.
steps: Dice chicken into bite-sized chunks and season with salt and pepper.
In a pot, heat oil over medium heat and sauté minced garlic for 1 minute.
Add chicken and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Pour in 4 cups of water (chicken broth would be ideal — see note below) and bring to a gentle boil.
Add broccoli florets and simmer for 8–10 minutes until tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and a small splash of soy sauce for depth. Serve hot.
